ShortDescription.Value: Remembers tool panel settings per savegame (draw mode, snap, height...) with configurable sharing scope.

LongDescription.Value:
## **English**
Tired of redoing the same tool options every time you enter a save? **Tool Mode Memory** remembers how you left the tool panel — draw mode, snapping, parallel roads, height, placement modes and more — and brings those choices back when you return.
Every savegame gets its own memory file. Leave a save, come back later, and your setup is still there.
**Sharing scope** is configurable per tool item:
- Same group (e.g. all small roads) - Same menu (roads, education, ...) - Same asset type (alley, metro track, ...) - Shared globally - Per asset (not shared)
Turn the master switch **off** for 100% vanilla behaviour. Memory management (reset / open folder) and links live on the About tab.
Zero Harmony. Does not modify game files.
## **中文**
每次进档都要把工具选项重设一遍？**Tool Mode Memory** 会记住你离开时的工具选项——绘制模式、吸附、平行道路、高度、放置模式等——下次进入该存档自动恢复。
每个存档单独一份记忆，退出覆盖保存。
**共用范围**可按工具项配置：同组 / 同菜单 / 同类资产 / 全局共用 / 全局不共用。
总开关关闭 = 完全原版行为。重置记忆、打开记忆文件夹与链接在「关于」页。
零 Harmony，不修改游戏文件。
